title: 4th of July DUI Checkpoint - Drug Dogs, Searched without Consent, while Innocent
summary: A driver films a police DUI checkpoint on the 4th of July where a drug dog alerts on his car and he is searched without consent, though he broke no laws. He is released without charges after officers learn he was recording.
why: HN commenters cite it as an example of police cueing drug dogs to justify searches.

quote.text: Here's a step-by-step video of what they do for anyone interested that also shows them cue the dog
